<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/api/v1.0/suppliers/query"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Retrieves suppliers using the legacy GET variant of the query endpoint. The controller marks this route as obsolete and recommends the POST version for modern integrations, because POST supports richer request-option payload patterns.

**Prerequisites**
1. None. Use this when a client must use GET semantics.

**Workflow Example**
1. Start with [GET /api/v1.0/suppliers/query](/docs/api/suppliers/get-suppliers-by-query-legacy) for basic retrieval.
2. When you need richer filter payloads, switch to [POST /api/v1.0/suppliers/query](/docs/api/suppliers/get-suppliers-by-query).
3. Use returned `Items[].SupplierId` values with [GET /api/v1.0/suppliers/\{supplierId\}](/docs/api/suppliers/get-supplier-by-id) or update/delete workflows.

**Minimal Required Fields**: None.

**Deprecated Behavior**: The source marks this GET route as obsolete in favor of POST.
